typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

diagram.description:
The {@link ParsableDiagram} which has been parsed and whose results
are stored in the {@link artifact}.

pipeline.description:
The {@link MlPipeline} which executed the diagram parsing logic.
Most often, it is a computer vision machine learning routine that
is used to parse a {@link ParsableDiagram}. In these cases, this
field will reference the {@link MlPipeline}.
In the rare case when machine learning routines are not employed,
it is encouraged to extend this Type IF auditability is desired.

artifact.description:
The result of parsing the {@link ParsableDiagram} will be stored
in a {@link ParsedDiagramExtractArtifact}. A common use case will
be to store the text extracted from a diagram in {@link File}(s).

sensors.description: The {@link ParsedSensor}s associated with this extract.

numSensors.description: Number of {@link ParsedSensor}s associated with this extract.

numVerifiedSensors.description: Number of verified {@link ParsedSensor}s associated with this extract.

percentVerifiedSensors.description: Percentage of {@link ParsedSensor}s on the diagram that have been verified.

title:
The result of parsing a {@link ParsableDiagram} will be stored in this Type.
Note that there may be multiple {@link ParsedDiagramExtract}s for a single
{@link ParsableDiagram}.
name: ParsedDiagramExtract
